view: PA (recorded); frontal chest radiograph, L marker in image upper-right corner confirming conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate but limited: low lung volumes (right hemidiaphragm dome at ~anterior 5th rib), under-penetrated lower zones/upper abdomen (retrocardiac and subdiaphragmatic regions washed out), scapulae not fully cleared from the upper lateral lung fields bilaterally, no significant rotation.

devices.type: External side marker 'L' with technologist initials (radiographic lead marker)
devices.location: Upper-right corner of the image, i.e. patient's left upper chest, outside the thorax

abnormalities.finding: Prominent, ill-defined hila with increased perihilar and basal vascular/interstitial markings (right > left); could represent mild vascular congestion / interstitial edema, but crowding from low lung volumes is a confounder. No alveolar consolidation, no definite Kerley B lines.

Marked elevation of the right hemidiaphragm with crowding of right basal vessels; lucent crescent beneath the dome likely posterior costophrenic recess (colonic interposition not excluded). Right costophrenic angle not well assessed.
Cardiac silhouette at the upper limit of normal / borderline enlarged (CTR ~0.5), assessment limited by low inspiration
Prominent / unfolded aortic knob with slightly wide upper mediastinum (partly body habitus and projection)
Low lung volumes (hypoinflation); scapulae projected over upper lateral lung fields
No definite pleural effusion (left costophrenic angle sharp; right limited by elevated hemidiaphragm); no pneumothorax; bones intact

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（影像右上角可見L標記，符合常規方向），吸氣量偏低，右側橫膈明顯上抬，下肺野及上腹部穿透不足。雙側肺門陰影增粗且邊緣略模糊，肺門周圍及右下肺野血管與間質紋理增加，可能代表輕度肺血管充血或間質性肺水腫，但亦可能部分為低肺容積與右側橫膈上抬造成之血管聚集，故判讀上不確定；未見明顯肺泡性實質病變、Kerley B線或明確肋膈角鈍化。心影大小接近上限（心胸比約0.5），主動脈弓突出。未見任何導管、引流管、心律調節器或手術夾。
